title: On the Subtractive Ideal Structure of Commutative Semirings
summary: In the theory of commutative semirings, the lack of additive inverses creates a structural divergence between ideals and congruences that does not exist in ring theory. The aim of this article is to restore critical ideal-theoretic properties via the subtractive property. We first prove a subtractive analogue of Krull's existence theorem, guaranteeing the existence of $k$-prime ideals disjoint from multiplicative sets.
